notes: Karts racing laps around a Rainbow Road track with a starting line and a finish line is Racing, and the answers settle the shape: the user explicitly declined sections crossing over each other, so route-circuit rather than route-multitier, which drops the P2 that shape would have carried. Stunt Circuit is the preset the Rainbow Road reference points at, but once its shape is swapped for a plain non-crossing loop its option set is Circuit Racing's, so that is the honest name — spawn-grid for the karts starting together, trigger-lap for lap counting, barrier-guardrail to hold them on the ribbon, plus the startpoint-line and trigger-finish the prompt asks for outright. Two counts this format cannot hold: three laps per race and up to four karts on the grid. Kart customization, the pre-race countdown and the pedal controls are mechanics, not layout, and I kept guardrails rather than an open void edge because the user chose the simpler, easier-to-race build.
